```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
n <- sample(4:6,1)
xbarbar <- sample(seq(50,80,1),1)
Rbar <- sample(seq(4,10,0.5),1)
A2 <- c("2"=1.880,"3"=1.023,"4"=0.729,"5"=0.577,"6"=0.483)[as.character(n)]
UCL <- round(xbarbar + A2*Rbar,2)
```
Question
========

A Shewhart $\bar X$ chart is used with subgroup size $n=`r n`$. The process has $\bar{\bar X}=`r xbarbar`$ and $\bar R=`r Rbar`$.

Calculate the upper control limit (UCL) of the chart.

Solution
========

$UCL=\bar{\bar X}+A_2\bar R=`r UCL`$.
